scripts.ci:
CIN=$(date +%s) && vp install && vp run lint && vp run pretest && vp run test:only && vp run posttest && echo "
✅ CI takes $(($(date +%s) - CIN))s
"
scripts._ci:admin:
CI_ADMIN=$(date +%s) && vp install && vp run rm && vp run up && vp install && vp run _ci && vp install && echo "
✅ Admin CI takes $(($(date +%s) - CI_ADMIN))s
"
scripts.ci:admin:
FULL_CI=$(date +%s) && pnpm run _ci:admin && pnpm run ci && echo "
✅ Full CI takes $(($(date +%s) - FULL_CI))s
"
scripts.pnpm:devPreinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./package.json')); const version=require('child_process').execSync('pnpm -v').toString().trim(); pkg.packageManager='pnpm@' + version; fs.writeFileSync('./package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n');"
scripts.rinit: vp run rm && vp run config
scripts.lint: vp run -r pack && vp run fmt && vp run lint:fix
scripts.rm: vp run rimraf -- node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml && pnpm clean --lockfile
